solid_materials_moon.title: Solid cabin materials at Moon-base air
solid_materials_moon.summary: No solid cabin material, such as fabric or plastic, has been fire-tested in this dataset at Moon-base air (30% oxygen or more at 10.2 psi or less). The only tests at those conditions used gas fuels on a burner, not cabin materials.
solid_materials_moon.evidence: The material fire tests that report oxygen ran at 13.6 to 22.2% (bass2, saffire1, saffire2). ACME CFI-G's 17 hot-flame tests at 33 to 39% oxygen and 7.35 psi used gas fuels on a spherical burner.

partial_gravity.title: Partial gravity (Moon 0.16g, Mars 0.38g)
partial_gravity.summary: No experiment in the PSI database was run in lunar or Martian partial gravity, so flames at Moon gravity are not covered by this dataset. ACME E-FIELD is not a stand-in, because it is not a partial-gravity test.
partial_gravity.evidence: 0 partial-gravity flight experiments in PSI. 23 of 24 experiments ran in microgravity and 1 (psi142) is a ground study in normal gravity.

pressure_records.title: Missing per-test pressure records
pressure_records.summary: ACME BRE and FLEX-2 reach Moon-like oxygen and low pressure in their ranges, but PSI does not record which pressure went with which test. So neither is a confirmed Moon-base match.
pressure_records.evidence: BRE's flight log lists 34% oxygen on 13 of 18 test days but does not identify the chamber pressures. FLEX-2's table lists oxygen and pressure options for each fuel, not for each test.

missing_values.title: Blank oxygen and pressure values
missing_values.summary: Only 10 of 24 experiments report oxygen and only 8 report pressure, so most cannot be checked against Moon conditions at all. A blank means unknown, not zero.
missing_values.evidence: 14 of 24 rows report no oxygen and 16 of 24 report no pressure. 13 report neither.
